1. Purpose & Scope

2. Core Entitlements & Allowances
The standard corporate schedule defines medical insurance limit as follows:
- Standard Allowance: 1200000 INR
- Tier-1 Metro Cap: 1200000 INR
- Special Exception Cap: Reimbursable up to 1.25x with VP signoff.

3. Eligibility & Pre-Conditions
Employees become eligible for this provision after formal orientation. Level-3 and above personnel in Healthcare & Benefits are pre-authorized.

4. Exceptions & Escalation Matrix
Waivers to the 1200000 INR limit require formal written authorization from the Head of Healthcare & Benefits and Legal Counsel.

5. Compliance & Non-Compliance Penalties
Any intentional misrepresentation or unauthorized circumvention of these rules shall be subject to formal disciplinary action and immediate revocation of privileges.
